Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoveryPercentag: Default percentage of XP recovered when reading a journal. Per-category overrides below take priority when not set to -1.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverRecipes_to: If enabled, recipes learned during gameplay will be stored in the journal and recoverable on read.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverPassiveSki: Recovery % for passive skills (Fitness, Strength). Set -1 to use default. Set 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverCombatSkil: Recovery % for melee combat skills. Set -1 to use default.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverFirearmSki: Recovery % for firearm skills. Set -1 to use default.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverCraftingSk: Recovery % for crafting skills. Set -1 to use default.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverSurvivalis: Recovery % for survivalist skills. Set -1 to use default.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverFarmingSki: Recovery % for farming skills. Set -1 to use default.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_TranscribeSpeed_t: Multiplier for how fast writing and reading progresses. Higher = faster.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_OneTimeUse_toolti: If enabled, each journal can only be read once per player. The XP is consumed on read.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_CraftRecipe_toolt: Override the journal crafting recipe inputs. Leave blank for default (Notebook + Glue + 3 Leather Strips + Thread).
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_DeductRadioTVXP_t: If enabled, XP gained from radio and TV will NOT be recorded in journals.
Sandbox_JeevesJournals_RecoverMapKnowled: If enabled, map locations revealed by fliers and brochures will be stored in the journal and restored on read.
